rulings: CF-ONE-SALE-ONE-ADDRESS (2026-09-05): one eBay sale resident under two cardId partitions is a split pool AND a double count. Never a delete — RETIRE marks flaggedWrong, PARK marks identityUnverified, and both are reversible.
PRODUCT axis (Drew, #1827): the title decides which product a dual-filed sale belongs to; the title naming neither product parks both.

PARALLEL axis (Drew, 2026-09-05): title-decides extends to the parallel axis when the PRODUCT agrees. Keep the copy whose parallel the title states. A title naming NO parallel keeps the base copy only if the rival parallel has no checklist support, else park both.

CANONICAL-COPY rule: a copy is canonical when its cardId partition equals its hobbyiqCardId AND its setKey is not a maker/parser default (unknown, bare bowman). Exactly one canonical copy retires the rest; zero or several parks all.
The title predicate is K.storedParallelStatedInTitle from rematch-classify.cjs — the SAME reader repair-finish-collision-refile uses, never a second copy of it.
